postBuildHooks.linux/*: sh -c 'ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd) && mkdir -p "$ROOT/build/bin" && find "$ROOT/cmd/desktop" -name pebblepost -type f -exec cp -f {} "$ROOT/build/bin/pebblepost" \; && rm -rf "$ROOT/cmd/desktop/cmd" "$ROOT/cmd/desktop/web"'
postBuildHooks.windows/*: sh -c 'ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd) && mkdir -p "$ROOT/build/bin" && find "$ROOT/cmd/desktop" -name "pebblepost*.exe" -type f -exec cp -f {} "$ROOT/build/bin/" \;'
